SEO Missions is SEOwind’s dedicated tool for performing keyword gap analysis. It helps you uncover high-value keywords your competitors are ranking for, but you aren’t. Whether you’re looking to boost organic visibility, improve your content strategy, or just make smarter SEO decisions, SEO Missions gives you the data and structure to take action with confidence.

Let’s walk through how it works.

### **Step 1: Add Your Competitors** [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/seo-missions/\#0-toc-title)

Start by listing the domains of your top competitors. SEOwind gathers data from the SERPs, extracting keywords your competitors rank for and organizing it in one place.

![seowind seo missions](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/SM1-1024x553.png)

### **Step 2: Let SEOwind Analyze the Data** [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/seo-missions/\#1-toc-title)

SEOwind scans and compares keyword performance across the websites you’ve entered. It evaluates each keyword based on:

- Search Volume – How often people search for it

- Match – How many of your competitors are ranking for it

- Keyword Difficulty – How hard it is to rank

- Cost Per Click (CPC) – Indicates commercial intent

- Search Intent – Whether users are looking to buy, learn, or compare

- Priority Score – Identify strategic keyword value


This analysis reveals both low-hanging fruit and long-term content opportunities.

### **Step 3: Select Keywords to Target** [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/seo-missions/\#2-toc-title)

Once the data is ready, SEOwind presents you with a curated list of keyword opportunities. From there, you can analyze and choose keywords that offer the best balance of search volume, competitiveness, and strategic fit. Focus on terms that are relevant to your business goals, align with your existing or planned content, and have the potential to drive meaningful traffic and conversions.
